description.value: Lynx Cafe is a food truck located on the Sea to Sky Highway in Pemberton, offering a convenient stop for cyclists passing through this mountain community. Operating in the fast food tradition with fish and chips and coffee, it provides quick service for travelers. The truck represents a casual, mobile dining option along the highway corridor.
